items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: I got bumped off the bandstand by the best, including Bud Powell... you look and you see it’s Bud Powell.

ctx.x: Oh man. Monday nights was jam session night, and everybody would come in and I got bumped off the bandstand by the best, including Bud Powell.
How would that happen? Getting bumped off the bench?
